items.name: Wood
items.description: Gathered from dead branches. Used to upgrade the campfire, craft, smelt, and cook.

items.name: Stone
items.description: Gathered from rubble. Used to upgrade the campfire and make Relay Braziers.

items.name: Rough Fiber
items.description: Gathered from dried grass. Used to make Bandages and Iron Lanterns.

items.name: Red Berries
items.description: Picked from red berry bushes. Eat them raw or use them in Baked Berry Cakes and Warm Frostcap Stew.

items.name: Frostcap
items.description: Grows in the shade of the Old Mill and in the Ice Gorge. Used in Warm Frostcap Stew.

items.name: Iron Ore
items.description: Mined at the Old Mill and Ice Gorge. Smelt two ore to make one Iron Ingot.

items.name: Iron Ingot
items.description: Smelted from Iron Ore. Used for equipment, Relay Braziers, and the Level 3 campfire.

items.name: Baked Berry Cake
items.description: A portable baked ration that restores 36 fullness.

items.name: Warm Frostcap Stew
items.description: Restores 24 fullness and halves torch drain at night for 90 seconds. Stacks with lanterns.

items.name: Bandage
items.description: Restores 2 health. Requires missing health.

items.name: Iron Lantern
items.description: While carried, reduces night-time torch drain to 75% of normal.

items.name: Iron Spear
items.description: While carried, sets attack damage to 2 and attack range to 1.75 tiles.

items.name: Relay Brazier
items.description: Lights an unused fire station in the Old Mill or Ice Gorge, creating a permanent 5-tile light radius.

items.name: Ember Seal
items.description: The Overseer and the Pyre Warden each guard one. Collect both to light the eastern beacon.

items.name: Beacon Core
items.description: An ember left by the old Beacon Keeper, used by generations of fire patrols.

items.name: Raw Meat
items.description: Frost-cold game meat. It can upset your stomach when raw, but it is excellent roasted.

items.name: Thick Pelt
items.description: A snowy woodland pelt suitable for sewing warm clothing.

items.name: Ember Dust
items.description: Faintly warm, dark-red dust that glows brightly enough to keep black fog away.

items.name: Pine Resin
items.description: Sticky, flammable pine sap that keeps torches and campfires burning longer.

items.name: Charcoal
items.description: Thoroughly charred wood used as fuel and in forging.

items.name: Iron Scrap
items.description: Iron salvaged from the Old Mill and frost armor. Reforge it into weapons.

items.name: Frost Crow Feather
items.description: A light, cold-resistant dark feather for crafting light equipment.

items.name: Snow Herb
items.description: A bitter plant that grows in cracks in frozen earth. Crush it to treat wounds.

items.name: Grilled Meat
items.description: Hot, smoky roasted meat that restores energy and helps heal injuries.

items.name: Snow Herb Salve
items.description: An herbal salve made with resin that quickly soothes wounds.

items.name: Resin Torch
items.description: Restores a large amount of torchlight. Use it outside camp to ignite the tile ahead. Fire spreads through dry vegetation.

items.name: Fur Cloak
items.description: A heavy pelt cloak lined with Frost Crow Feathers to block the bitter woodland wind.

items.name: Charcoal-Tempered Blade
items.description: A short blade reforged from scrap with charcoal. It can cut through frost armor.

items.name: Ember Lantern
items.description: An iron lantern filled with Ember Dust that keeps a steady ring of light in black fog.

items.name: Wrought-Iron Buckler
items.description: While carried, charges every 14 seconds and automatically blocks the next enemy attack.

items.name: Wrought-Iron Breastplate
items.description: While carried, adds 2 maximum health and reduces incoming damage by 1, to a minimum of 1.

items.name: Iron Snow Boots
items.description: While carried, increases movement speed by 10% and reduces Snow Dash cooldown by 0.35 seconds.

items.name: Heavy Wrought-Iron Helm
items.description: Adds 2 maximum health, 0.25 seconds of invulnerability after a hit, and 15% cold resistance.

items.name: Frostpine Cone
items.description: Plant to grow a Frostpine.

items.name: Ash Birch Sapling
items.description: Plant to grow an Ash Birch.

items.name: Emberpine Seed
items.description: Plant to grow an ancient Charpine.

items.name: Snowberry Cutting
items.description: Plant to grow a Snowberry bush.

items.name: Toughgrass Tuft
items.description: Plant to grow Tundra Toughgrass.

items.name: Bittergrass Seed
items.description: Plant to grow a cluster of Snow Herbs.

items.name: Ice Bog Reed Root
items.description: Plant near water to grow Ice Bog Reed.

items.name: Coldlight Spore
items.description: Plant to grow a glowing Frost Fungus.

items.name: Ash Compost
items.description: In Survival, immediately advances growth and speeds seedling growth for 180 seconds.

items.name: Ember Mulch
items.description: Advances growth by one stage and accelerates ripening and protects against blizzards for 240 seconds.
